description: Masking cases for the global billing services (parity-billing, parity-frontend; parity-billing PLAN §4.5), on top of cases.v1.json, which every service passes and which stays unchanged (its consumers check its classes exactly). Same normalize rules. classify adds the class email: the value is replaced by '[email]', whatever it is (0.10.2, FE-044: logs carry ids, never an email or a hash of one, keyed or not; a hash is a membership oracle). secret adds the tokens, signatures and the hosted Stripe URLs (they authorise a payment page or a portal session). plain lists billing ids that must stay readable.
